steps.name: verify the full libvirt domain is absent before create
steps.command: inventory=$(virsh --connect qemu:///system list --all --name) && printf '%s\n' "$inventory" | awk '$0 == "ubuntu-server-amd64-sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2-dev-alchemy" { found = 1 } { print } END { exit (found ? 1 : 0) }'

steps.name: create the test VM
steps.command: DEV_ALCHEMY_LIBVIRT_URI=qemu:///system ./sailwright create ubuntu --type server --arch amd64 --name sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2

steps.name: start the test VM
steps.command: DEV_ALCHEMY_LIBVIRT_URI=qemu:///system ./sailwright start ubuntu --type server --arch amd64 --name sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2

steps.name: destroy the test VM
steps.command: DEV_ALCHEMY_LIBVIRT_URI=qemu:///system ./sailwright destroy ubuntu --type server --arch amd64 --name sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2

steps.name: verify the full libvirt domain is absent after destroy
steps.command: inventory=$(virsh --connect qemu:///system list --all --name) && printf '%s\n' "$inventory" | awk '$0 == "ubuntu-server-amd64-sw-linux-lifecycle-a1b2-dev-alchemy" { found = 1 } { print } END { exit (found ? 1 : 0) }'
